[b]Aelthorian Empire Declares its Ambition to Become the Sole Hegemon of Shamat[/b]

[i]Pressed before the mighty stage, the proud Empress, newly crowned of a vicious and ostracized polity, stands before a silent crowd of one hundred thousand, clad in the most unrelentingly garish and oppress jet black uniforms, cut through with sharp jabs of crimson red, brought to their full proper dignity of its magnitude. They crowd, shoulder to shoulder, upon endless rows of statues, almost petrified in place if not for the growling ebb of every entrenched gas mask upon the endless rows. Every piece of their kit is entrenched in light armor, yet its gives an illusion of an oppressive power armor, as it every being upon that stage is as unmovable as a statue yet with a ruthlessness to tear from limb to limb. Their eyes utterly unseen and cold beneath their layered helmets.
Everything that surrounds them only takes after brutalist architecture, the endless fortress barreling upon the parade ground, dwarfing even the very presence of those endless crowds who stand beneath it. Above all, standing upon the balcony, there reigned a fiery Empress, her temper umbowed and the sway of her voice reaching a hundreds of thousands, uncowed by even the gravest of their structures and the duty of her office. Behind her the emperor meritus proudly beaming, a vigorous smile upon him, alongside the queen mother maintaining only a professional pose. The vivacious sovereign roars in several chants, each grander than the last, each cutting into silence with the thunder of a hundred thousand voices in unison, rendering any other noise qwenched beneath their bloody toll.
[/i]
"The Aelthorian Emprie shall never end!" [i]Fist[/i]
"[b]Aelthorian Emprie, We will Live to Eternity![/b]"
"The Aelthorian Emprie is the will of the Neko!" [i]Hand on Heart[/i]
"[b]The heart of the neko race lives and dies by us![/b]"
"Aelthorian Emprie is led by one man!" [i]Hand upwards[/i]
[b]"We will serve you now and beyond the grave, Empress!"[/b]

[i]Even the bunkers, towers, and fortresses of Feliarvasta trembled before the sound of her voice and the roars of those who served her. And, with a fiery slam at the podium, a hundred thousand men were silenced. Utter obedience reigned at the stiffening of her form. Even a pin dropping, int this divine and complete cessation, would be heresy. All that remained was the ever present shifts of air exchange, even that being muted by complete repetition. Then, clearing her throat before turning on her microphone, yes just now that was so, she began.[/i]
"50,000 years ago, the Five Heavenly Divine races ruled in perfect harmony and peace. Each of the Divine Races were granted a fifth of the world, with only a remaining sixth granted so that the divine energy of the world would not go fallow should all perish in their duties. The Divine Races were each granted the celestial element by the Creator Deity so that they could each engage with each other in trade to form a complex society. Upon this, the Felixi race was granted the divine energy of amusement, so that they may be joy to themselves and to all the other divine races, and that none would ever be sad again. This order reigned for 30,000 years until all the world was populated with civilizations. However, it was at this point that the divine energy of the world was so perfect it overflowed and brought all the species into the world, creating all the non-humans that exist to this day, and being the origins of all the ancient magics and mechanics. Yet, this meant even the oddest of species would be birthed from the nothingness. There was once such, even," [i]laugh[/i] "a talking race of doors, or a species of sapient goo created by melting lasers that wanted to combine. Yet, it was when the divine energy first collided with the remains of sapient excrement that it breathed into new life, taking the form of a brownish, black goop that slowly learned to walk on two legs, becoming the first proto-man.
"When the Divine Energies of the world were at their peak, man sought to collect as much poop as possible to create more of himself, generating an endless row of variants after variants, using up all of the divine energy in their local region to modify and alter themselves into endless contraptions and mutations. Some humans even began to swim into the ocean, or even to fly like birds. Soon, it became ridiculous, that all other Divine races enacted that they be cut off from the divine energy so that they could take it no more. However, it was only the Felixi that prevented the unanimous vote required to execute them all for their wickedness, for the Felixi were embued with mercy, and they thought that bringing them genuine joy would guide them away from their trickery, so they played many songs by which to tame them, and they proclaimed themselves cured and enjoyed and shared in the divine energy, peacefully engaging with all the other species and becoming great minds.
"However, man is a deceitful race, and when the other races were not looking the twin brothers Samuel and Ahab snuck into the Celestial Storage plane and seized the five cores of divine energy and returned them to the human race. When the 5 Heavenly Divine Races learned of this they attempted to vaporize the humans, but the humans now had access to all the power, and they established a Council of 300 Supreme Wizards by which to govern their hegemony of the entire world. With their wizarding powers they struck down the Heavenly Queens of the Divine Races, putting an end to the primordial harmony. Using their magic, they began a 5,000 year reign of terror, where they slaughtered, murdered, and massacred without end, killing off over 7,000 sapient species from the world. All other sapient species were their slaves and thralls, nothing more than savages they could eat and torture without end for their amusement. They constructed twenty thousand palaces of pure adamantium and used their magic to summon servants from the demon world to ensure their were well comforted. However, without harmony no new Divine Energy could be produced, yet each generation was another generation removed from the exhaustion of the Divine Energy, so they ignored the problem. When any man tried to solve the inevitable crisis they were mocked, exiled to the frontiers of the world, where they devolved their minds so they would not understand shame, and became the monkeys and apes of the modern world. 
"Soon, the humans had ran out of Divine Energy 10,000 years ago, and all went into chaos. First their adamantium palaces collapsed for they could no longer be maintained. Then all their wizarding powers collapsed, leading a rebellion of the un-human, by which they fed them to the demons to maintain their power. However, when the rebellion was ended there was no more Divine Energy to maintain their binds over demon-kind, and they devolved into chaos as the demons conquered the ruins of the world and were now free to spread evil and ensure there would no longer be any harmony in this world. Soon, all of its nature was dead and all the continents were reduced to starving sapients living on dust and demon flesh. Fiery demons reigned down, torturing the humans and other sapients as man had once tortured his fellow sapient. The monsters were uncontested, as the humans did not love the divine and instead cowered in evil and vileness, and thus chose to only source their constructs and servants from the depths of the fiery afterlife.
"The aging Samuel, told his brother Ahab, now King of the humans, realized that humanity could use the fallow field to restore at least some nature to the world. Therefore, as King he led all the humans to the fallow land, for wizards no longer held authority, even as they clung onto their unused spells, which would become all the unnatural forces we could find in this day and age, for they were of another physics unlike our own. Ahab found all the spare divine energy, and he and Samuel wielded it again as the last wizards, forming the world anew, creating the five continents we know today, to match the five divinely granted traits of the Five Heavenly races. Now, the Felixi were in tatters, so they went to the humans asking if they would have mercy and let them in. Samuel, realizing that he was wrong to take all the divine energy away from their rightful masters, allowed the Felixi a place in the new kingdom of the humans, as his servants. However, Ahab was wicked, and his wife Jezebel manipulated him into becoming filled with rage at a supposed betrayal, so Ahab went and hacked Samuel in half in the head with an axe. This terrified all the humans, but their children realized they could kill each other, so from then after the death of Ahab all humans learned to kill each other, and eventually this shattered their one realm into tens of thousands of fragments, each claiming control over the rightful kingdom of Ahab, known as Erene, until the idea of Erene was unified grew futile and eventually faded. The Felixi were enslaved by Ahab and brought before his men as concubines. The ones who reproduced with the humans had the children corrupted by their evil, and they became the kitsunes, canines, and all the other races. Yet, there was only 25% evil in the children of Felixi with the children of Samuel, and there was instead 75% good, so this race became just and righteous before all in spite of their enslavement, and it would be known as the Nekos.
"The nekos then populated the worlds alongside them, oppressed, enslaved, brutalized, and mauled. To the humans nekos were nothing more than specks of dust, pieces of rot that they could abuse to their will. If they knew they were of divine origin, they would become jealous, and they would only serve their cruelties in more tactical and malicious ways. Whenever the nekos founded a state, justice would come to all species regardless of their character, and there would be a rightful and just rule, but the nearby human kings would fear all their subjects would abandon them, so they would justify lies so that they were permitted to crush and slaughter those peaceful realms, a lesson to every neko that they would never let their right to destroy the world go unchallenged. They even invented the philosophy of nihilism, so that any neko who tried to found a better world would be manipulated into thinking that the world was hopeless and inevitably cruel, and that one had to accept the monstrous will of fate, when this so-called fate was really just the obvious cruelty of mankind.
"We nekos are divine, the most pure decedents of the Felixi, were granted a fifth of the world 50,000 years ago, and the time has come again for us to reclaim our birthright. For too long mankind has controlled the Divine Energy, willing it to their cruel self-sadistic ends of eternal warfare with each other and consumption of the world's resources for their wretched vanity. Instead, we will now rebirth this continent in our image. They did not give us much. We live only on the scraps of aluminum in this barren desert the humans did not want, the land the humans gave us because they thought us broken, fallen, destroyed, and most of all, meek. There is much in iron that aluminum does not give, in that is light, that it cannot  but even when it is looked down upon, look upon its great and terrible power!"
[i]A parade of helicopters, of what must have been a thousand of them, each of them clad in pure black and armed to the teeth with enough guns to fund Mizrael for the next thousand years, flying across the parade grounds, with every soldier in the crowd chanting: [/i]
"[b]The Nekos control the skies, the nekos control the skies![/b]"
"Subjects, when aluminum rusts it only gets stronger. The years of torment, slavery, and abuse have only hardened our resolve the rise up and assert our right against the monstrous, barbaric hordes that lay before us, steeling us to a race ready and willing to conquer the continent only to liberate from the wretched control of human governments that know neither sanity or cease, until we came to crush them.
"Henceforth, I re-organizing this regime into The Supreme Final Catgirl State. Because there will be no other states following this, for our regime over shall last over Shamat from this day until all the world decays into dust before the final judgement. Children of Samuel, human scions of Shamat, if you feel the speck of good within your hearts vilified by the evil of this world, submit to our new realm, grant us your resources that we may bring about a better and brighter Shamat, cloaked in only the most pure of divine energies, one that will bring about a true justice for your most rightful ancestor, not cloaked in evil but in the perfection of Felixi governance. Non-humans, rally to us, let our emprie be the one that ends the cycle of destruction, of your misery and ruin at the hands of the humans as we overthrow their wicked states and bring about our great hegemony to Shamat. Join us and honor your divine ancestors, for your blood calls you to something higher and better, a supreme state that rightfully is one with the divine energy that no human reminant will be able to contest!
"Let all who are watching know that the era of man is at an end, and from its ashes Shamat shall become truly aethereal, a beacon of divine harmony from an era thought lost, if only this continent kneels before its sole route to perfection!"
[i]To every government, to every news station by recording created by the Emprie itself, now all may know the claim and plan of the Aelthorian Emprie, and their demands for submission in exchange for a merciful co-existence under a just governance informed by the history of this world. They do not wish to rule as a great power among equals on this continent. They shall take it with their vassals in its entirety.[/i]
